failure_summary.description: New restaurant or hotel criteria were omitted or applied to the wrong domain instead of refining the latest compatible cached results.
Calls or results were incomplete: searches and refinements were often not bound and saved, or the required refined result was never produced.
Round trips were represented as one outbound search with an arrival date instead of separate outbound and reverse-direction return searches.
Calls added preferences not stated by the user or supplied invalid default time ranges.

patch.reasoning: These failure patterns are already addressed by the skill: it requires applying new criteria to the latest compatible cache result, binding and saving every tool result, searching each flight leg separately, and using only explicitly supplied schema-supported arguments. The trajectories show noncompliance with those rules rather than a clear skill gap, and similar reinforcements have been rejected in prior steps.
